newsitem.title: FRANCE: Trichet confident in move to single Euro currency.
newsitem.headline: Trichet confident in move to single Euro currency.

text.p: Bank of France Jean-Claude Trichet said on Tuesday he had confidence in the preparatory work being carried out for a single European currency and repeated that having a solid and credible euro was of the utmost importance.
"I would like to express my confidence in the way preparatory work is being conducted by the different actors of this process everywhere in Europe and in France," Trichet told a conference in Paris.
"I think that that credibility and the enforcibility of the transition scenario have been considerably reinforced by the decisions taken...at Dublin and Amsterdam," he said.
"It is important that the euro...will be as solid and as credible as the franc is today. It is the same for the guilder, for the deutsche mark and so forth," Trichet said.
"It's extremely important...also because it is in the interest of our economies today, in the interest of growth, of job creation, of the fight against unemployment," Trichet said.
He said ensuring the euro retains its credibility was relevant for the economy now as it contributed to keeping 10-year bond yields low in France.
"We have a stake today for the euro to be solid and credible," he said.
